priorityList: Use Avenging Wrath when Divine Toll has 10 seconds or less remaining on cooldown.
Cast Divine Toll while Avenging Wrath is active.
Cast Hammer of Light if the target has the Judgment debuff and either Undisputed Ruling is down or the Hammer window is expiring.
Spend Holy Power on Shield of the Righteous if Hammer of Light is not ready, or to prevent overcapping after using Divine Toll.
Cast Holy Armaments (Sacred Weapon) if the buff is missing or has less than 6 seconds remaining.
If Hammer of Light is ready but Judgment is not on the target, cast Hammer of Wrath or Judgment to apply it.
Cast Avenger's Shield if Vanguard is active or during Avenging Wrath.
Cast Holy Armaments (Holy Bulwark) if you have 2 charges or Avenging Wrath is coming off cooldown in less than 5 seconds.
Cast Consecration if you have 5 stacks of Divine Guidance or if it is not currently active.
Cast Hammer of Wrath whenever available.
Cast Judgment if it is about to reach maximum charges.
Cast Avenger's Shield as a priority filler.
Cast Blessed Hammer or Hammer of the Righteous if the Blessed Assurance buff is active.
Cast Blessed Hammer or Hammer of the Righteous to generate Holy Power.
Use Word of Glory if you have a Shining Light proc.
